Bret Weinstein returns to the Joe Rogan Experience for episode 2408. Weinstein, the evolutionary biologist behind the DarkHorse podcast, uses his Rogan visits to give long updates on his running themes. This one catches him in his heterodox professor mode, at full stretch.

He talks through the lab-leak fight, the failures he charges to mainstream science and media, and the years since he left teaching. Rogan, an old ally, mostly clears the road and lets him run. The episode is a dispatch from a man who built a second career outside the academy, and it shows why his audience keeps growing.
